service.description: Whether a row would register or change one piece of equipment of the batch's organization (scopeKey), changing nothing: the source key (required; one asset a source system and key), the equipment it names (by ID or by source key, of the organization, not stock), a new one's name, the asset class, the model, a location of the organization (equipment already elsewhere is moved in Maintenance, not by import), the custodian and the warrantor, the supplier warranty's end as a date and the starting reading (a number, of one of the model's meters or a meter type, not below the last reading of a counting meter). A holder of MAINTENANCE_IMPORT and MAINTENANCE_RESOURCE_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses an organization outside their maintenance scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED).

One validated row, rechecked against the current state: store#MaintenanceEquipment (new equipment of the organization, or the identity of the equipment named), its source key kept (AssetIdentification AitMntSourceKey), change#MaintenanceCustody when the custodian changes and record#MaintenanceMeter for a starting reading not yet recorded, as the importer. A row applied again changes the same equipment and records no second reading (resultRef: the assetId). Nothing posts.

The organizations an equipment import may be for and whose imports the caller may read: the internal organizations of their maintenance scope, for a reader of equipment (MAINTENANCE_RESOURCE_VIEW or a broader maintenance view). None otherwise.
